record.question: By what percentage did the production increase from 2018 to 2023, based on the values shown in the bar graph?
record.explanation: Use the numeric labels printed on the original graph: 2018=60 and 2023=90 thousand units. Percentage increase=(90−60)÷60×100=50%, option C. The source bar lengths are inconsistent; this solution follows the printed values. Verified worked solution; unofficial.
